description: For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.

b.request: Count distinct projects per `archstat` in the QC data, treating missing status as its own group; calculate each status’s share as its count divided by the sum of counts across statuses; return only statuses whose share exceeds the average share, showing status, count, share, and share minus average without rounding
b.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, project_count,
         project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, project_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();

c.request: In the QC data, tally the projects under each archival status (`archstat`), with a missing status treated as its own group. Work out each status's share as its tally divided by the sum of the tallies over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the tally, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding. For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.
c.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally,
         tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat AS status,
       tally,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()

a.request: For each archival status (`archstat`) in the QC data, with a missing status treated as its own group, count the distinct projects (`arcref`) that have QC records with that status. Work out each status's share as that count divided by the sum of the counts over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the count, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding.
a.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, project_count,
         project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, project_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()

d.request: In the QC data, for each archival status (`archstat`), counting missing status as its own group, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Calculate each status’s share by dividing its count by the sum of counts across all statuses. Return only statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses, showing the status, count, share, and share minus the average share, with no rounding.
d.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
shares AS (
  SELECT archstat,
         project_count,
         project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT archstat,
         project_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT archstat, project_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
